_comment: Subunits Phase 2 declared frontage demo (#1289): a 140-man Spearmen regiment staged alone in drill mode. The declared subunit size (16, lochos) automatically dictates a 9-file frontage (ceil(140 / 16) = 9) at full strength without any player frontage override. The regiment is selected (showing the derived 9-file selection bounds) and issued a short march order to show the 9-file phalanx stepping off in clean rank/file order.
